title: MOVE 1234567 TO PIC 9(4) silently truncates — ON SIZE ERROR only on COMPUTE, not MOVE
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SHORT-FIELD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> WS-SHORT is 4 digits. Moving 1234567 in leaves '4567' --
      *> truncated from the LEFT (not the right!). NO ON SIZE ERROR
      *> is raised because ON SIZE ERROR only applies to COMPUTE,
      *> ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE -- not plain MOVE.
       01  WS-SHORT    PIC 9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1234567 TO WS-SHORT.
           DISPLAY WS-SHORT.
           STOP RUN.
notes: Silent left-truncation on MOVE is a major source of data-loss bugs that survive testing because the test data fits. A Java rewrite that does '(int) longValue' truncates differently (low bits, not high digits). Surface the truncation direction + the no-error policy as invariants.
